name: @datatechsolutions/tympan-workspace
description: Tympan, an Astrlabe-family component published by Datatech: design tokens (@datatechsolutions/tympan-tokens), accessible React components with the flow and provenance canvas as the /flow subpath (@datatechsolutions/tympan) and data-book print components (@datatechsolutions/tympan-print).
author: Natalia Mesquita

scripts.build: npm run build -w @datatechsolutions/tympan-tokens && npm run build -w @datatechsolutions/tympan && npm run build -w @datatechsolutions/tympan-print
scripts.lint: npm run check:no-utility-css && npm run check:logical-css && npm run check:provenance && npm run check:elements
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
